program.name: Five-Split 60 Tempo
program.subject: Signature
program.blurb: The Five-Split body-part days, but Levels II and III slow every lowering to three seconds instead of adding reps and weight.
program.about: The same five-day body-part split as Five-Split 60: chest, back, legs, shoulders and arms, then abs and cardio. Everything is straight sets, with abs to close. Five-Split 60 adds reps and then weight; this one keeps the weights and slows down, with a three-second lowering on every move that can take it at Levels II and III. Each muscle gets its own day, so the slow reps go where they count. Suits you if you like focused sessions and want each set to be harder without a heavier weight.
program.split: Chest / back / legs / shoulders & arms / abs & cardio
